subject: Clarify per-token commit & request for invoice export
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rivera <elena.r@pivotalfin.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify per-token commit & request for invoice export

Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Per our call, PivotalFin is evaluating a 12-month committed volume with a stepped per-token discount as usage ramps (3 tiers). To move forward with legal and procurement, your procurement team asked for a sample invoice showing line-item token breakdowns and a usage export for the trailing quarter so they can validate the math.

Two asks I can action this week:
- I can generate a CSV export that breaks usage down by model, route (text vs embeddings), and token counts per day. Would that be sufficient for procurement?
- Confirm the commit baseline: you mentioned ~1.5B tokens/month initial commit, scaling to 3.0B by month 6 — can you confirm those numbers so I put them into the draft SOW?

I’m looping in Jordan (sales ops) to prepare the export and Vivek to finalize the discount schedule. If you want, I can also include a toy sample invoice that maps per-token charges to line items so your accounting team has a quick reference.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none in this message

From: Elena Rivera <elena.r@pivotalfin.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@pivotalfin.com>, PivotalFin Billing <billing@pivotalfin.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify per-token commit & request for invoice export

Monica —

Thanks, that plan sounds good. A CSV with daily token counts by model and by route will work; please also include the invoice lines as they would appear on our monthly statement (we want to map the per-token line item to G/L codes).

Quick clarifications:
- Confirm whether the stepped discount is applied to gross usage or just to committed baseline (we bill overages differently).
- Can you indicate on the sample invoice how credits/one-time discounts appear? Procurement also wants to see where a one-time onboarding credit would be applied so it’s not confused with recurring tiered pricing.

If you can send the exports and a sample PDF invoice, I’ll route to our accounting and procurement for validation.

Elena
VP Finance, PivotalFin
elena.r@pivotalfin.com

Elena / Michael —

Per Monica’s note, attached is a generated export for Oct–Dec 2026 and a sample invoice PDF showing how per-token charges map to line items. The export includes these columns: date, model, route (text|embeddings|rerank), tokens_in, tokens_out, total_tokens, unit_price_cents, line_total_cents. I added a sample "one-time onboarding credit" line at the bottom to show netting behavior.

Attachment (zipped for upload): billing_export_Q4_2026.csv
Attachment: sample_invoice_per_token_Q4.pdf

A couple of notes on the stepped discount behavior:
- Our default is to apply tiered discounts to the committed baseline first, then to overages at the agreed overage rate unless contract language specifies otherwise.
- If you prefer a blended effective unit price applied to all usage once a higher tier is hit, we can model that — let us know which approach procurement prefers and we’ll produce both samples.

Vivek — any suggested language for the SOW about credits and how they appear on invoices?

—Jordan
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rivera <elena.r@pivotalfin.com>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@pivotalfin.com>, PivotalFin Billing <billing@pivotalfin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-22T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarify per-token commit & request for invoice export — export attached

Elena —

Thanks for the quick review. To be explicit for the SOW and procurement:
- Commit: 1.5B tokens/month for months 1–3 at $0.00045/token (tier 1), 2.25B tokens/month for months 4–6 at $0.00039/token (tier 2), and 3.0B tokens/month thereafter at $0.00033/token (tier 3).
- Overages: billed at $0.00060/token unless a blended pricing clause is elected.
- One-time credits: appear as separate line items labeled "One-time credit — onboarding" and are applied as a negative line on the invoice before tax.

We attached the CSV export and a redlined SOW (redline_SOW_v2.pdf) in case legal/procurement want the exact language. If procurement confirms the commit numbers above I’ll ask legal to issue a SOW and we can push the DocuSign link.

Next steps for PivotalFin: confirm commit volumes and whether accounting wants blended vs tiered discounting on historical invoices. If they want both samples, we’ll provide a second sample invoice showing blended effective pricing.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
